lessons.goal: 在新情境中辨別期限、時長與預留時間。

questions.evidence: For the weekly review, five cards read duration, procedure, subtitles, combined, and buffer. The last word is new, so the teacher adds a clue: a few spare minutes between finishing lunch and catching a bus. This extra time can absorb a small delay.

options: The printed words on a screen.

questions.prompt: What does the teacher use to explain buffer?

options: Combined.

questions.evidence: A second exercise gives a plan that ends at exactly the bus departure time. It fits the listed times but has no buffer. One student wants to call the plan guaranteed. Her partner asks what would happen if ordering lunch took two extra minutes.
questions.explanation: 恰好壓線沒有緩衝，稍延誤即錯過。
options: The plan contains no times.
A small delay could make the bus impossible to catch.
A buffer always makes people late.

questions.prompt: Why is guaranteed an unsuitable label for the second plan?

A schedule fits the estimates and still has no spare time.

lessons.story:
For the weekly review, five cards read duration, procedure, subtitles, combined, and buffer. The last word is new, so the teacher adds a clue: a few spare minutes between finishing lunch and catching a bus. This extra time can absorb a small delay.

The group uses duration for how long a show lasts. Procedure belongs beside the steps for collecting tickets. Subtitles are written words on the screen, while a combined ticket covers two named programs under one purchase. Students explain each match with a short example.

A second exercise gives a plan that ends at exactly the bus departure time. It fits the listed times but has no buffer. One student wants to call the plan guaranteed. Her partner asks what would happen if ordering lunch took two extra minutes.

The group writes two separate judgments: mathematically possible under the stated times, but sensitive to delay. They keep that wording because it says more than simply good or bad. A precise explanation should show both what works and which condition could change the result.
lessons.title: Before, After, and Enough
